text1: The fathers of Ashish and Manish are brothers. Ashish and Manish are male. How is Manish's father's only son related to Ashish's son?
hint: Manish's father's only son is Manish himself!
know_more: Ashish and Manish are first cousins. Manish's father's only son is Manish. To Ashish's son, Ashish's cousin is an Uncle!

text1: I am a number that comes after 35 and before 52. My tens digit is 2 more than the units digit. Which number am I?
hint: The tens digit must be 4. What is 4 - 2?
know_more: Between 35 and 52, tens digit 4 gives units digit 4 - 2 = 2. So 42 is between 35 and 52 and 4 is 2 more than 2!

text1: If you were to write the numbers below in words, spelling of which of them would have exactly one vowel in it?
hint: Spell each number and count vowels: A, E, I, O, U
know_more: T-W-O has only 1 vowel ('O'). FOUR has 2 (O, U), EIGHT has 2 (E, I), and NINE has 2 (I, E)!

text1:
Fill in the blank to make a meaningful sentence.
Can you tie a _____ properly?
hint: Think of shoelaces or ropes
know_more: A 'knot' is tied with string or rope. 'Not' is negation. 'Knout' is a whip. 'Naut' is a misspelling of nought.

text1: Each shape given below has a number in it. Which of the given options lists the shapes, whose numbers would NOT add to 9?
hint: Watch the word NOT! Calculate each option: 4+5=9, 3+6+0=9, 5+3=8, 3+6=9.
know_more: Triangle has 5 and circle has 3. So their sum is 8. Hence option C does not add up to 9

text1: Find the ODD one out among the numbers: 15, 25, 35, 49, 55
hint: Look at divisibility by 5 or the last digit
know_more: 15, 25, 35, and 55 all end in 5 and are multiples of 5. 49 is a square of 7 (7 × 7), not divisible by 5!

text1: Find the next term in the series: 4, 7, 12, 19, 28, ?
hint: Find the difference between consecutive numbers: +3, +5, +7, +9...
know_more: The pattern adds consecutive odd numbers: 4 (+3) = 7; 7 (+5) = 12; 12 (+7) = 19; 19 (+9) = 28; 28 (+11) = 39!

text1: What will come in place of '?' in the pattern: (3, 6, 18), (4, 5, 20), (6, 7, ?)
hint: Multiply the first two numbers in each group
know_more: In each group, the third number is the product of the first two: 3 × 6 = 18, 4 × 5 = 20, and 6 × 7 = 42!

text1: A right-angled triangle pointing right is hidden without any rotation. Which shape contains it?
answer: Rectangle with diagonal from bottom-left to top-right
option1: Rectangle with diagonal from bottom-left to top-right
hint: Dividing a rectangle diagonally creates right-angled triangles
know_more: Cutting a rectangle from corner to opposite corner creates two right-angled triangles with upright sides without rotation!

text1: Four friends ran a race: Kevin finished before Leo. Maya finished after Nina. Leo finished before Nina. Who came in LAST?
hint: Order them from 1st to 4th: Kevin -> Leo -> Nina -> ?
know_more: The finishing order from first to last is: Kevin (1st), Leo (2nd), Nina (3rd), Maya (4th). Maya finished last!

text1: If yesterday was Tuesday, what day of the week will it be 4 days after tomorrow?
hint: If yesterday was Tuesday, today is Wednesday, and tomorrow is Thursday
know_more: Yesterday = Tuesday => Today = Wednesday => Tomorrow = Thursday. 4 days after Thursday is Friday (1), Saturday (2), Sunday (3), Monday (4)!

text1: Choose the correct word to complete the idiom: Actions speak louder than ________.
hint: What people do is more important than what they say
know_more: The proverb 'Actions speak louder than words' means that people's intentions are judged by their deeds, not their talk.

text1: In a secret code, CAT is coded as 3-1-20 and DOG is coded as 4-15-7. How is PIG coded?
hint: Find the position of P, I, and G in the alphabet
know_more: Each letter is replaced by its alphabet position: P is the 16th letter, I is 9th, and G is 7th, giving 16-9-7!

text1: Rohan walks 10 meters North, turns left, and walks 5 meters. Which direction is he facing now?
hint: When facing North, left is West and right is East
know_more: Facing North, turning left turns you 90° counter-clockwise towards West!

text1: Maya is 9 years old today. Her brother Arjun is 3 years younger. How old will Arjun be when Maya is 15 years old?
hint: The age gap between siblings never changes!
know_more: Arjun is 9 - 3 = 6 years old today (3 years younger). When Maya turns 15, Arjun will be 15 - 3 = 12 years old!

text1: If in a certain language, 'Deva is good' is coded as 'AT ON TO' and 'How is Sumit' is coded as 'TO PO GO', then what is the code for 'is'?
hint: Do not match by word position! Find the word that appears in BOTH sentences.
know_more: In both sentences, 'is' is the only common word, and 'TO' is the only common code. Never assume word 1 = code 1; ciphers can scramble the order!

text1: Which letter satisfies BOTH conditions? a. Letter which comes after T in HUNTER. b. Letter which comes after C in DOCTOR.
hint: List letters after T in HUNTER and after C in DOCTOR
know_more: In HUNTER, letters after T are E and R. In DOCTOR, letters after C are T, O, and R. The common letter is R!

text1: Third day from today (excluding today) is a Saturday, then which day of the week is tomorrow?
hint: Count backwards from Saturday: Day 3 is Saturday, Day 2 is Friday, Day 1 is tomorrow
know_more: Day 3 = Saturday, Day 2 = Friday, Day 1 (tomorrow) = Thursday, and Day 0 (today) = Wednesday!

text1: Karan is standing on a beach facing north. If he makes the movements stated below, after which would he face a direction OTHER than east?
option4: Turn right, then right, then left
hint: Facing South after 180°, turning right points towards West
know_more: North + 180° = South. From South, turning right faces West, NOT East! The other three all result in East.

text1: Which of the given options CANNOT be used to fill in the blanks to make a meaningful English sentence? He asked, 'If he could ________ on Tuesday?'
hint: Read aloud with each option before 'on Tuesday'. Watch for double 'on'!
know_more: All the other words can be used except 'come on' as that would lead to having two 'on's one after another ('come on on Tuesday') which is incorrect English.
